audience: warehouse teams using Infoplus to review stock and orders

useCases.title: Review item reorder metadata
useCases.text: Find items by SKU or status, then inspect packaging and reorder metadata to prepare for an inventory review.

useCases.title: Inspect stock quantities and lots
useCases.text: Read a page of inventory quantities, lot details and warehouse location IDs. Open a stock detail record to investigate a specific result.

useCases.title: Check order shipping progress
useCases.text: Find an order and read its status, amounts and shipped quantities from up to 100 line items to prepare a progress update.

useCases.title: Review incoming shipment notices
useCases.text: Search advance shipping notices for an inbound review, then open a notice to inspect up to 100 receipt lines.
